transcript.text: What was the total net revenue for the anchor region in calendar year 2025? Compute net revenue as amount minus discount over completed orders only, amounts are integer US cents (divide by 100), in USD rounded to the nearest cent.

args.intent: net revenue completed orders amount discount cents

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) as net_cents, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'North'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
